title: Correction to: Integrative taxonomy using historical specimens provides evidence for a single species of bushbuck, Tragelaphus scriptus (Mammalia: Bovidae)
content: This is a correction to: C Nicolas Baird, Mario Ernst, Isabelle Waurick, Mozes P K Blom, Faysal Bibi, Integrative taxonomy using historical specimens provides evidence for a single species of bushbuck, Tragelaphus scriptus (Mammalia: Bovidae), Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society, Volume 204, Issue 4, February 2024, Pages 532–546, https://doi.org/10.1093/zoolinnean/zlad096
siteTitle: Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society Current Issue
